title: (Deprecated) Submit materials
content_data:
Use this endpoint to submit materials for dynamic scene creation. After you submit the materials, use [/dynamic_scene/task/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740317320231938) to create an asynchronous task. > **Note**
The Dynamic Scene API is now in beta. If you would like access to this feature, please apply for the allowlisting using the [Allowlist Management](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/blog/detail/7102266224578396162) page. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/dynamic_scene/material/submit/| /v1.3/dynamic_scene/material/submit/| |Request parameter data type |`advertiser_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/dynamic_scene/material/submit/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string| Advertiser ID. | #|slots {Required}|object[]|Max size is 6.| ##|order {Required}|number|The order of slot in the story arc, ranging from 0 to 5.| ##|tag {Required}|string|The tag of a slot.| ##|video_ids {Required}|string[]|You can get video IDs through [Video Upload](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737587322856449) endpoint. Note: You can only pass in no more than 10 videos in this field. | ##|mute|boolean|Whether to turn on the original soundtrack of a slot. The default value is `false`. If you set it to `true`, then `bgm_volume` is `100`.
Note: In the case of no background music (`auto_soundtrack` is `false` and there is no `music_ids`), you are not allowed to set `mute` to `true`. | ##|bgm_volume|number|The volume of background music, should be an integer, ranging from [0, 100].| |auto_soundtrack|boolean|Whether to use automatic soundtrack provided by the system. If you want auto soundtrack, set it equals to `true`. The default value is `false`.| |music_ids|string[]|Music materials. You can get music IDs through [Music Upload](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740052650395650) endpoint. | ``` ### Example ``` xcodeblock (code curl http) { "slots": [{ "order": 0, "tag": "asd", "video_ids": ["32wdsd3232784yjfvh343dsf"], "mute": false, "bgm_volume: 30 }], "auto_soundtrack": false, "advertiser_id": 75960823018 } (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object|Returned data.| #|material_package_id|string|Material package ID.| |request_id |string|The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. | ```
